_info: Ring‑MQTT configuration with inline comments (keys starting with _ are ignored by ring‑mqtt)
_note: Only keep the real keys (without underscore) in production if you prefer a strict JSON.
_enable_cameras: true = publish camera/doorbell devices and all their entities to MQTT
_enable_modes: Set to true if you want Home Assistant tiles to change Ring Modes (Home/Away/Disarmed)
_livestream_user_pass: Username/password embedded in every RTSP URL ring‑mqtt serves
_livestream_startup: 'all' = open a cloud session for every camera at container start; 'none' waits for demand
_logging: Set log_level to 'info' and enable_debug false once things are stable
_snapshots: Ring still images pushed to MQTT/HTTP
_snapshot_mode: 'interval' = grab a frame every N seconds; 'motion' = only on events
